data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Turkish word for 'gold'. The name Altin carries the meaning “Golden” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Turkish, Uzbek, Tatar. Parents who choose Altin usually hope their child will grow to embody golden and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Altin total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: ألتين
in_arabic.long_meaning: ألتين هو اسم مشتق من الذهب أو المعدن الثمين، ويرمز إلى القيمة والغنى. في اللغة العربية، الذهب هو معدن ثمين يرمز إلى الثراء والنجاح. وقد استخدم هذا الاسم في بعض الثقافات الإسلامية كرمز للنجاح والتميز.

in_urdu.name: الٹین
in_urdu.long_meaning: الٹین ایک ایسا نام ہے جو سونے یا قیمتی چیز سے ماخوذ ہے۔ یہ نام ثروت، کامیابی اور معیار کی علامت ہے۔ اردو میں، یہ نام اکثر ایسے شخص کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو کامیاب اور ممتاز ہو.

in_hindi.name: अल्टिन
in_hindi.long_meaning: अल्टिन एक ऐसा नाम है जो सोने या मूल्यवान वस्तु से लिया गया है। यह नाम धन, सफलता और उत्कृष्टता का प्रतीक है। हिंदी में, यह नाम अक्सर सफल और विशिष्ट व्यक्ति के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: التین
in_pashto.long_meaning: التین داسې یو نوم دی چی د سړی ګاڼه یا ډالۍ څخه ګرفته شوی دی. دا نوم د شتمنۍ، بریالیتوب او ځانګړتیا نښه ده. په پښتو کې، دا نوم ډیری وختونه د بریالي او ځانګړي شخص لپاره کارول کیږي.

in_english.name: Altin
in_english.long_meaning: Altin is derived from the Arabic word for gold or precious metal. It symbolizes wealth, success, and excellence. In Islamic tradition, gold is considered a valuable and auspicious metal. The name Altin is used in various Muslim cultures to signify a person of high value and distinction.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Altin" holds immense cultural significance for the Turkish community. Historically, gold was a symbol of wealth, power, and prestige in Turkish society. It was believed that owning gold represented prosperity and a high social standing. Therefore, the name "Altin" became a popular choice for parents who desired to give their child a noble and prestigious name.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, gold is often associated with the spiritual journey towards enlightenment and purity. In Islamic teachings, the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) is described as having a golden complexion, representing his purity and inner radiance.
